brief:
# 闖禍小浣熊 EP3〈電視〉

## 故事前提

豆豆踢球砸壞電視，坐進空框裡當電視。爸爸拿起遙控器停了半拍才按——他知道。豆豆只好跟著換台：新聞主播、購物台推銷青蔥。最後一聲老電視關機音，豆豆在框裡躺平「關機」，地毯底下滾出那顆足球，停在爸爸的拖鞋前。

## 角色

- 豆豆（doudou）、浣熊媽媽（mama）、浣熊爸爸（baba）：同系列定裝照。爸爸只有拿遙控器的手與一隻拖鞋入鏡。

## 站主觀點

零台詞；集數規劃盲評 82（`docs/videos/raccoon-mischief/episodes.md` 的 EP2）。採納評審建議（都不加鏡、不加角色）：第三台改成更荒謬的購物台推銷青蔥、爸爸按遙控器前停半拍（他在整人）、關機後地毯下滾出足球停在爸爸拖鞋前。

## 格式

- 9:16，約 16 秒；Colab 首格與 H3 片段。

## 大綱

### 選項 A：電視
一行說明：裂螢幕、射門定格 → 鑰匙聲、慢看鏡頭 → 自己坐進空框當電視 → 爸爸停半拍按遙控器 → 新聞主播 → 購物台推銷青蔥 → 關機、足球滾到爸爸拖鞋前。
開場鉤子：裂成蜘蛛網的電視冒著煙，小浣熊一腳還舉在射門姿勢。

shots.ff: Medium shot of the cozy living room: the TV on the wooden TV stand has its black screen cracked into a spiderweb, nothing displayed, a thin wisp of smoke rising from it; a football lies on the rug; Doudou the young raccoon himself in his yellow hoodie and red cape stands frozen in a follow-through kicking pose, one hind leg still raised in mid-air.
shots.clip: The young raccoon shown in <Picture 1> stays frozen mid-kick with one leg raised; the football rolls slowly across the rug and out of frame; smoke curls up from the cracked black screen. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: Close-up of Doudou the young raccoon's face in the foreground, red cape at his neck; behind him, out of focus, the front door.
shots.clip: The young raccoon shown in <Picture 1> holds still; the door handle in the background slowly turns down; his eyes slide slowly from the door to the camera and his ears flatten back. His mouth stays closed. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: Medium shot of the wooden TV stand: the TV is now only an empty black frame and the screen is gone; Doudou the young raccoon himself sits cross-legged inside the empty TV frame in his yellow hoodie, frozen in a cartoon dance pose with both arms up, his red cape tucked behind him; in front of the TV stand a big lump bulges under the rug.
shots.clip: The young raccoon shown in <Picture 1> holds his dance pose perfectly still inside the empty TV frame with a forced bright smile; one raised arm trembles slightly. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: Insert close-up of the arm of a beige sofa: a raccoon paw in a blue knitted vest sleeve with a white shirt cuff holds a plain remote control with no labels, pointing it off screen.
shots.clip: The paw in the blue vest sleeve shown in <Picture 1> raises the remote, pauses for half a beat, then presses a button firmly. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: Medium shot of the same wooden TV stand: Doudou the young raccoon himself sits stiffly upright inside the empty TV frame like a serious news anchor, front paws folded neatly in front of him, a stern face, red cape tucked behind him; a big lump bulges under the rug in front.
shots.clip: The young raccoon shown in <Picture 1> sits perfectly upright with a stern anchor face; only his eyes slide sideways toward the off-screen sofa and back. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: Medium shot of the same wooden TV stand: Doudou the young raccoon himself sits inside the empty TV frame like a home shopping host, holding up a big bunch of green onions toward the camera with both paws, a huge stiff salesman smile, red cape tucked behind him.
shots.clip: The young raccoon shown in <Picture 1> presents the bunch of green onions to the camera and turns it left and right like a product, with a stiff forced smile; his eyebrows twitch. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: Medium shot of the same wooden TV stand: Doudou the young raccoon himself sits inside the empty TV frame in his yellow hoodie; in front of the TV stand a big lump bulges under the rug; at the right edge of the frame a single raccoon hind paw in a brown slipper rests on the floor.
shots.clip: The young raccoon shown in <Picture 1> slowly leans back inside the frame, lies flat and closes his eyes as if switched off; a football rolls out from under the rug lump and stops against the slipper at the right edge. The camera holds a static shot.
